android_mechanism: Themed-font handling repeated expensive font work; fix performs the lookup/registration once
bug_description: MainPage.aboutToAppear unconditionally calls font.registerFont for two custom font families (iconfont.ttf and DINCOROS-Regular.ttf) every time the main page component is created. Each registration re-loads and re-parses the TTF files; navigating back to the main page (router.replaceUrl flows) repeats the work and delays page build, growing memory with duplicate typeface entries.
fix_summary: Font registration is guarded by a once-per-process static flag so the TTFs are loaded only on first creation.
trigger_steps: Launch the app; from the main page navigate to the location list and back (recreating MainPage) 10 times.
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched, disk) during the last 5 round-trips.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Time from MainPage creation (first build event in ace trace) to first frame rendered, averaged over recreations.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed shows TTF file reads + font registration work in the page-build path on every creation; fixed only on the first. unfixed_avg_build_ms > fixed_avg_build_ms (fixed approaches the no-font-work floor).

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 ace app sched disk -o /data/local/tmp/sep_font.chtrace
